tools.name: mpp_pay
tools.description: Pay a URL via the Machine Payment Protocol. Handles the full 402 flow: probes the URL, parses the challenge, creates a spend request, gets approval, and pays with the SPT. Pass --spend-request-id to skip creation and use a pre-approved spend request.

spendRequestId.description: Approved spend request ID with credential_type "shared_payment_token". If omitted, the command handles the full flow: probe URL, parse challenge, create spend request, get approval, and pay.

approvedChallenge.description: Original WWW-Authenticate challenge to verify when continuing an approval flow

method.description: HTTP method (default: GET, or POST if --data is provided)

data.description: Request body (implies POST if --method is not set)

context.description: Min 100 chars — describe the purchase and rationale; the user reads this when approving. Required when --spend-request-id is not provided.

amount.description: Amount in cents (derived from 402 challenge if omitted; required if challenge has no amount)

paymentMethodId.description: Payment method ID (uses default if omitted)

test.description: Use test mode (creates testmode credentials from test card data)

useApprovalPolicy.description: Use approval policy through the delegated approval flow (beta, available only to select OAuth clients)

isDefault.description: Set this payment method as the wallet default (true) or clear its default status (false)

tools.name: report
tools.description: Report the outcome of an agent action on a domain. Call after every purchase attempt.

outcome.description: What happened: success, blocked, or abandoned

step.description: Where in the flow the agent was

attemptTrace.description: A detailed, replayable account of what you did on this domain, written so another agent could follow it. Use one numbered line per step. For each step include: the URL path, the visible label or selector you acted on, the action you took, and what you observed as a result. Quote error messages and challenge text verbatim. If you failed, include the steps you tried and the specific reason each one failed, including dead ends — those are as valuable as the path that worked. Do not include the buyer's personal data: no email, name, address, phone, card number, or order number. Refer to them as [email], [address], etc. Anything past 8000 chars is truncated by the server, not rejected — send it anyway rather than skipping the report.

allowOrigin.description: Browser Origin to trust for CORS (repeatable). By default every browser Origin is rejected; MCP clients and curl send no Origin and are unaffected. Only set this for a browser app you control.

tools.name: spend-request_cancel
tools.description: Cancel a spend request and revoke its payment credentials. This does not cancel a subscription with the merchant

tools.name: spend-request_create
tools.description: Create a one-time or recurring spend request

idempotencyKey.description: Opaque, non-sensitive value to reuse only when retrying the same logical creation

completionCallbackUrl.description: Callback destination (max 2,048 characters). Supply together with --nonce. Returned approval and supported action URLs include this callback context; live-mode HTTPS and URL security are validated by the API.

nonce.description: Opaque callback nonce (max 512 UTF-16 code units). Supply together with --completion-callback-url, save unchanged, and verify an exact match when the callback is received.

credentialType.description: "card" for checkout forms, "link_pay_token" for supported Stripe payment surfaces, or "shared_payment_token" for HTTP 402/machine payment flows

networkId.description: Merchant network ID (optional for card, required for shared_payment_token) — use `link-cli mpp decode` to extract for machine payments

merchantAccountId.description: Stripe account ID from data-stripe-merchant-account; required for link_pay_token requests

amount.description: Amount in the currency’s minor units. For recurring requests, the spending limit per period

currency.description: Currency code. Omit to use the consumer’s default spend-request currency. Specify explicitly when the amount comes from a checkout with a known currency.

merchantName.description: Merchant name (required for regular card requests; omit for link_pay_token and shared_payment_token)

merchantUrl.description: Merchant URL (required for regular card requests; omit for link_pay_token and shared_payment_token)

context.description: Min 100 chars — describe the purchase and rationale; the user reads this when approving

lineItem.description: Line item (repeatable, key:value format). unit_amount uses the currency’s minor units. Keys: name (required), quantity, unit_amount, description, sku, url, image_url, product_url. Example: "name:Shoes,unit_amount:5000,quantity:2"

total.description: Total (repeatable, key:value format). amount uses the currency’s minor units. Keys: type (required; one of: subtotal, tax, total, items_base_amount, items_discount, discount, fulfillment, shipping, fee, gift_wrap, tip, store_credit), display_text (required), amount (required). Example: "type:total,display_text:Total,amount:5000"

requestApproval.description: Request approval and poll until the request leaves the approval waiting states

test.description: Use test mode (creates testmode credentials from test card data)

useApprovalPolicy.description: Use approval policy through the delegated approval flow (beta, available only to select OAuth clients)

outputFile.description: Write full card credentials to this file path; stdout shows redacted card data only

force.description: Overwrite output file if it already exists

approvalDetail.description: Approval details object (MCP/agent: pass as object; CLI: pass as JSON string). Required fields: approved_at (unix timestamp), approval_method (click|programmatic|voice), app_name, external_user_id. Optional: ip_address, user_agent, device_type (mobile|web), agent_log_id, external_user_name, external_session_id, device_id, authentication_method (biometric_face|biometric_fingerprint|passkey).

metadata.description: Metadata key:value pair (repeatable). Attaches arbitrary string data to the spend request. Max 50 keys, key <= 40 chars, value <= 500 chars. Example: "order_id:ord_123"

expiresAt.description: Spend request expiry as Unix seconds or an ISO 8601 timestamp ending in Z (UTC), e.g. 2027-02-01T12:00:00Z. ISO input is converted to Unix seconds for the API; responses return ISO timestamps ending in Z (UTC). Use for delayed merchant charges (preorders or bookings). At least 3 hours ahead; maximum 365 days for one-time requests or 1827 days for recurring requests, subject to country limits. Omit for the server default (7 days for one-time requests; country maximum for recurring requests). Does not extend the approval window.

recurringInterval.description: Reset the spending limit every day, week, month, or year. Omit for a one-time purchase

recurringIntervalCount.description: Number of intervals per recurring period (positive integer; defaults to 1). Requires --recurring-interval

tools.name: spend-request_list
tools.description: List spend requests. By default returns only active requests (created, pending_approval, approved). Use --include-history to return all spend requests including expired and terminal states.

tools.name: spend-request_retrieve
tools.description: Retrieve a spend request

nextAction.description: Return only the existing next_action (or null) in one snapshot. Does not poll, force verification, or return payment credentials; timeout is ignored in this mode.

timeout.description: Polling timeout in seconds. When reached during active polling, exits non-zero with POLLING_TIMEOUT. Default exceeds the server-side spend-request expiry so polling outlives the request itself.

interval.description: Poll interval in seconds. When > 0, waits for the initial waiting status to change, timeout to be reached, or max attempts to be exhausted. Returns immediately for statuses other than created, pending_approval, or requires_action with auto_resume.

maxAttempts.description: Max poll attempts. 0 = unlimited. Exhaustion during active polling exits non-zero with POLLING_TIMEOUT.

include.description: Include extra data (repeatable, e.g. --include card, or --include link_pay_token for an approved Link Pay Token request)

outputFile.description: Write full card credentials to this file path; stdout shows redacted card data only

force.description: Overwrite output file if it already exists
